# ruff: noqa
# fmt: off
import datetime

from django.contrib.postgres.fields import ArrayField
from django.contrib.postgres.indexes import GinIndex
from django.contrib.postgres.search import SearchVector
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import Q
from django.db.models.functions import Length
from django.db.models.lookups import GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual

from iki_server.entities import checks
from iki_server.entities.fields import QuantityField
from iki_server.entities.models import Entity
from iki_server.files.models import File


class Sequence(Entity):
    """Sequence (dna.Sequence), schema version 1. Anything with a sequence of residues."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'dna.Sequence'

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255, null=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'dna_sequence'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('name'), 1),
                name='dna_sequence__name__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(name__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='dna_sequence__name__one_line',
            ),
        ]
        indexes = [
            GinIndex(
                fields=['name'],
                opclasses=['gin_trgm_ops'],
                name='name_trgm_b7235ac83d5ea378d286',
            ),
        ]


class Sequence_History(models.Model):
    """The history of dna_sequence: its values at each revision of each entity."""

    IKI_HISTORY_OF = 'Sequence'
    APPEND_ONLY = True

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity_id', 'revision')
    entity_id = models.UUIDField()
    revision = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    name = models.TextField(null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'dna_sequence__history'


class DNASequence(Sequence):
    """DNA sequence (dna.DNASequence), schema version 2."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'dna.DNASequence'

    sequence_ptr = models.OneToOneField(
        Sequence,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    bases = models.TextField()
    topology = models.TextField(null=True, db_default='linear')
    length = QuantityField(unit='{bp}', null=True, db_index=True)
    gc_content = QuantityField(unit='%', null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'dna_dnasequence'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('bases'), 1),
                name='dna_dnasequence__bases__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(bases__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='dna_dnasequence__bases__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(bases__regex='^[ACGTRYSWKMBDHVNacgtryswkmbdhvn]*$'),
                name='dna_dnasequence__bases__format',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(topology__in=['linear', 'circular']),
                name='dna_dnasequence__topology__values',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(length__gt=float('-inf'), length__lt=float('inf')),
                name='dna_dnasequence__length__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(gc_content__gt=float('-inf'), gc_content__lt=float('inf')),
                name='dna_dnasequence__gc_content__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(gc_content__gte=0),
                name='dna_dnasequence__gc_content__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(gc_content__lte=100),
                name='dna_dnasequence__gc_content__max',
            ),
        ]


class DNASequence_History(models.Model):
    """The history of dna_dnasequence: its values at each revision of each entity."""

    IKI_HISTORY_OF = 'DNASequence'
    APPEND_ONLY = True

    pk = models.CompositePrimaryKey('entity_id', 'revision')
    entity_id = models.UUIDField()
    revision = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    bases = models.TextField(null=True)
    topology = models.TextField(null=True)
    length = QuantityField(unit='{bp}', null=True)
    gc_content = QuantityField(unit='%', null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'dna_dnasequence__history'
